blocks.title: Four sprints in an afternoon
blocks.dek: Mike asked for a sprint on the hour for four hours and pointed at the mythos. What landed: /mythos with a Worlds Rail, RFC 0003 for plus-one agents, residents in the manifest, today's shelf on /briefs, and three new blocks declaring what PointCast actually is.
